answer: Since you're home for most of the day, I'd anchor the morning like this: blood pressure reading right after waking (before coffee and meds, so the caffeine doesn't skew it), your prepped quinoa bowl, then a 60-90 minute #GreenLivingWithMe work block with one "movement snack" every time you refill your water — slow spine roll, chest opener, standing leg swings — all gentle enough for your lower back and quiet enough for the apartment. Midday, eat your meal-prepped lunch away from the desk, then do a slow lap of the place to water and check the snake plant, fern, and terrarium; it doubles as a real walking break and a humidity check. Afternoon: two more focused blocks split by a longer 10-minute stretch (cat-cow, knee-to-chest, a relaxed wall push-off), and wind down after dinner with something low-key and off-screen like sorting comics or rearranging the figurine shelf, so you're not hunched at the monitor all evening.
